deploybot: :rocket: Pipeline started for staging
deploybot: tag: v2.3.1-rc5, commit: abcdef12, triggered by @alice
deploybot: steps: build -> lint -> unit -> e2e (parallel)

alice: quick FYI — change window still ok for this hour?
carol: yes, within the window. canary is green so far. staging is ok to run.

deploybot: UPDATE: lint failed (step: eslint) — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/1234/logs
deploybot: failing job: lint (container: lint-runner)

ben: pinging the logs now, grabbing the top error
ben: ```
/path/to/src/inference/runner.ts:42:5 - error: 'UnusedRunner' is defined but never used. (no-unused-vars)
  40 | export class Runner {
  41 |   private _cache: KVCache;
> 42 |   private unused: UnusedRunner;
     |     ^
```

dave: that looks like eslint rule is stricter after plugin bump in the last commit. I think this started when eslint-plugin-typescript got bumped to 1.4.0 in the shared-tooling change.

alice: right — we merged that dependency upgrade in release-tools earlier today (sha: baddcafe). can we either pin the plugin back or patch the offending file?

carol: what's our blast radius? is this blocking prod?
ben: only staging CI; canary already used previous artifact, so prod not affected. still, we shouldn't promote until lint passes.

alice: options: 1) fastpatch revert the tooling bump (revert commit baddcafe) and rerun CI; 2) add an eslint-disable-next-line for the one line and rerun; 3) pin eslint-plugin-typescript to 1.3.8 in package.json and lockfile, then rerun.

dave: prefer 3 - pin in package.json and update yarn.lock in a tiny commit. less risky than a revert of the whole tooling PR.

carol: agree. if it still flakes we can do a quick revert. 

alice: ok i'll push patch commit: 1234fix-pin -> updates package.json: "eslint-plugin-typescript": "1.3.8" and regenerates yarn.lock. will trigger a CI rerun.

deploybot: Pipeline retriggered for staging - commit: 1234fixpin (sha: fedcba98) - started lint

ben: monitoring the lint job...
ben: lint passed ✅
ben: unit tests starting

deploybot: UPDATE: stage pipeline finished — all steps passed. artifact: v2.3.1-rc5-hotfix1 (sha: fedcba98)

alice: great — proceeding with canary promotion in 15m. adding note to release changelog about the tooling pin.
carol: tagging the incident tracker as "ci:linter-regression" for visibility.

dave: thanks everyone — small and clean fix. :thumbsup:
